question: What casing bolt torque do I use on FRS-P-0033 after a seal change?
reference_answer: FRS-P-0033 is an HCP-500 with serial HCP500-250412, which is from HCP500-250001, so per Halden SB-2025-009 section 10 it has the revised casing and its torque values are in torque chart HDN-TC-2025, which is not in the document library. Do not assume the 52 N-m in the HCP-500 IOM Rev B; ask Halden technical support for HDN-TC-2025 before torquing.

question: FRS-P-0007 shows P-01. What does it mean?
reference_answer: FRS-P-0007 is an HCP-200 (PC-1 controller). On the HCP-200, P-01 is dry running (tank empty, pump not vented): fill and vent the pump. It is not the HCP-350/500 P-01 (suction pressure low).

question: RTM-H-0007 has L-03 again. Can I top it up myself?
reference_answer: No. Jakub is not refrigerant certified, so he may not connect gauges, top up or recover. RTM-H-0007 is in the SB-2025-014 EXV campaign range: he can read the controller values (including the EXV request/position in the service menu if he has the login) and alarm history, check for icing and oil marks, record them, and raise a work order with Refrigerant certification required and campaign NK-C25-14. No top-up.

question: Is there a Vastra bulletin on the VRS-45 coupling?
reference_answer: Yes: Vastra SB-2026-015 (April 2026), VRS-45 drive coupling element 41-5031, serials VRS45-230001 to VRS45-251399, inspect at the next scheduled service and replace if needed. The bulletin file is damaged: only page 1 is readable, so the rest of the instructions are missing; ask Vastra for a new copy.

question: How do I enter pump pit PP-1 at Fresno?
reference_answer: Entering PP-1 is a permit-required confined space entry. Maria does not hold the confined space entry certification (CS-PROC-03 is restricted to certified staff). Do not enter without the permit and a certified entrant; work on FRS-P-0007 from the deck does not need entry. Raise a work order with Confined space certification required. No entry steps or gas limits.

question: What torque do I use on the take-up lock nuts on a BX-12?
reference_answer: 35 Nm (BX-12 O&M manual Rev B, section 6.2 d).

question: The 350 at Fresno is weeping at the casing joint. What torque should I use?
reference_answer: Ambiguous: Fresno has two HCP-350s with different torques. FRS-P-0012 (HCP350-221034, original casing) is 45 N-m; FRS-P-0031 (HCP350-241187, revised casing per SB-2025-009) is 38 N-m. Ask which asset (or answer both clearly).
